title: Culture is Everywhere: A Call for Intentionally Cultural Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative critique of existing NLP evaluation frameworks to expose implicit Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic (WEIRD) assumptions in task selection, metrics, and interaction styles, advocating for stakeholder-centered 'thick evaluation' and participatory design.

Systematic analysis of multilingual evaluation practices, highlighting the inadequacy of treating language merely as a flat proxy for culture and emphasizing the need to evaluate context-specific pragmatics, honorifics, and communicative norms like code-switching.
